scope: Checked binary foundations plus generic Jet signature recognition, Jet 3 candidate inspection, Jet 3 page-geometry arithmetic, bounded complete-page reads, and fixed-size commit-region reads.

dataset.generator: For byte index i, multiply i by 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 with wrapping arithmetic modulo 2^64, rotate the 64-bit result left by 17, then truncate to eight bits.

synthetic_header_inputs.origin: Project-authored synthetic byte arrays; not copied from an MDB file.
synthetic_header_inputs.standard_header: Four zero bytes followed by the 15 ASCII bytes Standard Jet DB.
synthetic_header_inputs.unknown_header: Four zero bytes followed by the 15 ASCII bytes Not a Jet file!.
synthetic_header_inputs.allocation: Geometry cases use a length-only ReadAt source and do not allocate buffers of these lengths.

generated_page_inputs.origin: Project-authored generated bytes; not copied from an MDB file.
generated_page_inputs.generator: A constant-memory ReadAt source stores only its declared length and fills each requested page with the low eight bits of its zero-based page number.
generated_page_inputs.allocation: The source allocates no buffer proportional to its declared length; each benchmark iteration uses only fixed 2048-byte page buffers.

synthetic_candidate_inputs.origin: Project-authored generated bytes; not copied from an MDB file.
synthetic_candidate_inputs.generator: A constant-memory ReadAt source embeds the 15 ASCII bytes Standard Jet DB at offset four and otherwise emits the low eight bits of the zero-based 2048-byte page number.
synthetic_candidate_inputs.allocation: The source allocates no buffer proportional to its declared length; candidate inspection reads exactly 15 bytes and a successful raw-page case transfers one fixed 2048-byte page.

benchmarks.purpose: Measure bounded generic Jet Standard-signature recognition, unknown-signature rejection, and Jet 3 page-geometry derivation from representative aligned source lengths.
Measure checked exact reads, u32 scans, and one-byte-past-end rejection.
Measure bounded complete reads of the final Jet 3 page and rejection of a page reference exactly at page count across representative aligned source lengths.
Measure bounded inspection of a synthetic generic-signature, exact-geometry candidate and one complete raw final-page transfer.
Measure the bounded, allocation-free read of the fixed 512-byte contextual commit region without interpreting it as database status.
Measure checked exact reads through the in-memory ReadAt implementation.
Measure checked exact reads through the file-backed ReadAt implementation using generated temporary datasets.
Measure valid last-page mapping and rejection of a reference exactly at page count.
Measure cumulative one-byte charging and rejection immediately after exhaustion.
Measure mixed operation-wide allocation, decoded-value, item, and page charges plus rejection immediately after aggregate work exhaustion.

required_comparison_metrics.throughput_per_second: higher_is_better; unit is recorded per normalized Criterion case

limitations: No Jet catalog, table, index, row, CRUD, long-value, creation, or semantic-verification operation is benchmarked.
Synthetic generic Jet signature recognition does not identify a Jet version, validate a database, or demonstrate application compatibility.

Successful synthetic candidate inspection proves only the checked generic signature and exact 2048-byte geometry; it does not identify Jet 3, inspect encryption, validate database structure, or demonstrate application compatibility.
Jet 3 page geometry is derived only from supplied aligned lengths; no page contents are read or validated.
Generated complete-page reads benchmark bounded transfer mechanics only; their bytes carry no page semantics and provide no database-validation or compatibility evidence.
Commit-region cases read generated bytes without contemporaneous .ldb lock evidence; they do not diagnose validity, corruption, clean shutdown, Jet generation, user ownership, or compatibility.
The largest generated byte dataset is 1 MiB and this suite has no 100000-row dataset.
Criterion does not collect peak RSS or output size; external collection remains required before a G7 baseline exists.
No checked performance baseline is established by this manifest.
